theorem QOU.Archimedean.BlochRigidity.contDiffOn_of_fiveTerm {φ : ℂ → ℝ} (hφ : ContinuousOn φ {0, 1}ᶜ) (hinv : ∀ (z : ℂ), z ≠ 0 → z ≠ 1 → φ z⁻¹ = -φ z) (h5 : ∀ (x y : ℂ), x ≠ 0 → x ≠ 1 → y ≠ 0 → y ≠ 1 → x ≠ y → φ x - φ y + φ (y / x) - φ ((1 - x⁻¹) / (1 - y⁻¹)) + φ ((1 - x) / (1 - y)) = 0) :
ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) φ {0, 1}ᶜ

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BlochRigidity.contDiffOn_of_fiveTerm_core {φ : ℂ → ℝ} (hφ : ContinuousOn φ {0, 1}ᶜ) (hinv : ∀ (z : ℂ), z ≠ 0 → z ≠ 1 → φ z⁻¹ = -φ z) (h5 : ∀ (x y : ℂ), x ≠ 0 → x ≠ 1 → y ≠ 0 → y ≠ 1 → x ≠ y → φ x - φ y + φ (y / x) - φ ((1 - x⁻¹) / (1 - y⁻¹)) + φ ((1 - x) / (1 - y)) = 0) {X Y s : Set ℂ} (hX : IsCompact X) (hY : IsCompact Y) (hs : IsOpen s) (hsX : s ⊆ X) (hX0 : ∀ x ∈ X, x ≠ 0) (hX1 : ∀ x ∈ X, x ≠ 1) (hY0 : ∀ y ∈ Y, y ≠ 0) (hY1 : ∀ y ∈ Y, y ≠ 1) (hXY : ∀ x ∈ X, ∀ y ∈ Y, x ≠ y) {ψ : ℂ → ℝ} (hψ : ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) ψ) (hψ1 : ∫ (y : ℂ), ψ y = 1) (hψY : ∀ y ∉ Y, ψ y = 0) {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hYM : ∀ y ∈ Y, ‖y‖ ≤ M) :
ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) φ s

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BlochRigidity.mem_U {z : ℂ} :
z ∈ {0, 1}ᶜ ↔ z ≠ 0 ∧ z ≠ 1

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BlochRigidity.contDiff_invKernel {ψ : ℂ → ℝ} {M : ℝ} (hM : 0 < M) (hψ : ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) ψ) (hψ0 : ∀ (y : ℂ), M < ‖y‖ → ψ y = 0) (hψz : ψ 0 = 0) :
ContDiff ℝ ↑⊤ fun (w : ℂ) => Complex.normSq w⁻¹ ^ 2 * ψ w⁻¹

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BlochRigidity.integrable_of_vanish {F : ℂ → ℝ} {Y : Set ℂ} (hY : IsCompact Y) (hF : ContinuousOn F Y) (h0 : ∀ y ∉ Y, F y = 0) :
MeasureTheory.Integrable F MeasureTheory.volume

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BlochRigidity.contDiff_normSq {n : ℕ∞} :
ContDiff ℝ ↑n fun (z : ℂ) => Complex.normSq z

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BlochRigidity.contDiffOn_integral_kernel {φ : ℂ → ℝ} {U k s : Set ℂ} (hk : IsCompact k) (hkU : k ⊆ U) (hφ : ContinuousOn φ U) (hs : IsOpen s) {K : ℂ → ℂ → ℝ} (hK : ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (Function.uncurry K) (s ×ˢ Set.univ)) (hKs : ∀ p ∈ s, ∀ t ∉ k, K p t = 0) :
ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (fun (p : ℂ) => ∫ (t : ℂ), K p t * φ t) s

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BlochRigidity.integral_comp_inv_one_sub_mul {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (F : ℂ → ℝ) :
∫ (y : ℂ), F y = ∫ (t : ℂ), Complex.normSq (c / (1 - c * t) ^ 2) * F (1 - c * t)⁻¹

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BlochRigidity.integral_comp_one_sub_mul {c : ℂ} (hc : c ≠ 0) (F : ℂ → ℝ) :
∫ (y : ℂ), F y = ∫ (t : ℂ), Complex.normSq c * F (1 - c * t)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BlochRigidity.integral_comp_mul {x : ℂ} (hx : x ≠ 0) (F : ℂ → ℝ) :
∫ (y : ℂ), F y = ∫ (t : ℂ), Complex.normSq x * F (x * t)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BlochRigidity.integral_eq_compl_singleton (a : ℂ) (F : ℂ → ℝ) :
∫ (y : ℂ) in {a}ᶜ, F y = ∫ (y : ℂ), F y

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BlochRigidity.integral_image_holo {g g' : ℂ → ℂ} {S : Set ℂ} (hS : MeasurableSet S) (hd : ∀ y ∈ S, HasDerivAt g (g' y) y) (hinj : Set.InjOn g S) (F : ℂ → ℝ) :
∫ (t : ℂ) in g '' S, F t = ∫ (y : ℂ) in S, Complex.normSq (g' y) * F (g y)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.BlochRigidity.det_mul_eq_normSq (c : ℂ) :
LinearMap.det ↑(ContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight 1 c)) = Complex.normSq c
